Synopsis:
Dialog with the Brewer. He is a bloated creature who asks us to drink ourselves into oblivion with him. Player choices lead either to combat, or to the brewer drinking himself until he explodes.Twisted and creepy, a jovial barman who has been corrupted by curse to become a monstrous drunk. He speaks in fragments, swinging between melancholy, menace, and humour. Extra emphasis and derangment on bold words.

Cluster Contexts:
- TWN_Distillery_Brewer.json: The player is facing Theobald Thorm, a bloated, cursed barman who has become a monstrous, deranged drunk; he drags himself to the bar where two full mugs sit and jeers at the player to “drink… gulp it down.” His speech shivers between melancholy, menace, and awful jocularity, often fragmentary and unnervingly emphatic. In this scene the player can either attack (provoking combat) or allow Thorm to keep drinking until his curse makes him literally drink himself to explosion. Off-screen the wider area is in chaos: goblin guards were found slaughtered, the bear Helia is loose after breaking containment, children fled, and a nearby war drum can be struck to sound an alarm that will rile the camp.
- TWN_Distillery_Brewer_Zombie_03.json: Billy, one of the zombie patrons of the brewer used to be a troubador. Here he is bellowing out a drinking song - may be improvises as a song or chanted.
- TWN_Distillery_Brewer_Zombie_04.json: One of the zombie patrons in the Brewery. This is an actor whose heart was set on the Five Flagons in Baldur's Gate, but he got lost in his cups here.
- GOB_DrunkGoblin_Friend0.json: Goblin listening to another goblin's stories. He is very drunk and should be slurring his words.
- GOB_Festivities_Goblin006.json: A goblin at a party who has had far too much to drink already. He's celebrating the raid in which the goblins stole all of the booze they're now working their way through.

context: The player is confronting Theobald Thorm, the distillery’s once-jovial barman who has been corrupted by a curse into a bloated, deranged drunk that speaks in fragmentary, unnervingly emphatic bursts. He drags himself to the bar where two full mugs sit and urges the player to “drink… gulp it down,” alternating between melancholy, menace, and horrific jocularity. Off-screen the distillery is in chaos—goblin guards were found slaughtered, a captive bear (Helia) has broken loose, children fled, and a nearby war drum can still be struck to raise an alarm. Nearby zombie patrons (former revelers like Billy) bellow drinking songs; in this scene the player can either attack and trigger combat, or allow Thorm to keep drinking until his curse makes him literally drink himself to explosion.
